app.name: HB POS
bootstrap.title: Store checkout is being prepared
bootstrap.subtitle: Device approval, offline cash, peripherals and payment recovery are isolated behind durable contracts.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.title: Fix startup with an app update
bootstrap.otaRecovery.checking: Checking the server for an update for this terminal…
bootstrap.otaRecovery.applying: Downloading and verifying the update. The app restarts when it is ready…
bootstrap.otaRecovery.availableRequired: A required update has been published
bootstrap.otaRecovery.keepsData: Installing only replaces the app code and restarts. All data on this terminal, including unfinished payments, is kept.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.upToDate: No update is available for this terminal. Contact your administrator if the problem continues.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.deviceUnavailable: This terminal is not registered or is locked, so updates cannot be checked here.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.selectionChanged: The published update changed. Please check again.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.mismatch: The update does not match this installed app and was rejected. Contact your administrator.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.notAvailable: The update server has not provided this update yet. Please check again later.
bootstrap.otaRecovery.failed: Checking or installing the update failed. Check the network and try again.
bootstrap.error.secureStorage: Device security storage is unavailable. Check this build and try startup again.
bootstrap.error.generic: Startup could not complete. Check the device and network, then try again.
registration.title: Activate this handheld for store checkout
registration.subtitle: Scan a one-time device activation code created in HB POS Web. The server determines the branch and binds this installation after you confirm it.
registration.securityNote: The branch comes only from the signed one-time code. Local credentials and the encrypted ledger remain bound to this device installation.
registration.formHint: Scan the complete HBDEV1 code or enter it manually. Review the server-confirmed branch, platform and expiry before using the code.
registration.pendingHint: Keep this screen open or return later. HB POS securely remembers the pending registration and checks again every five seconds while online.
registration.lockedHint: Checkout, registration and scanner input are disabled. Reconnect and retry secure recovery before continuing.
registration.storeLoadFailed: Branches could not be loaded. Check the network and try again.
registration.storeEmpty: There are no active branches available for registration.
registration.runtimeUnavailable: The encrypted runtime is not ready. Retry startup before registering.
registration.activationCodeHint: ASCII spaces are ignored. The code is stored on this device only after final confirmation so an uncertain network result can be retried safely.
registration.activationExpiryUnavailable: Expiry is controlled by the server.
registration.activationInvalid: Scan or enter a complete HBDEV1 device activation code.
registration.activationPreviewRejected: The server did not allow this code for the current handheld platform. Request a new code in HB POS Web.
registration.activationRedeemRejected: Device activation was not completed. The code may be expired, used or assigned to another platform.
registration.state.pendingHint: This device remains registered locally and will check approval again while online.
registration.state.approvedHint: Authorization is complete. The checkout runtime is opening now.
registration.state.rejectedHint: Confirm the selected branch or contact a manager before trying again.
registration.state.disabledHint: Server policy has disabled this device. Contact an administrator.
serverConnection.title: Server connection
serverConnection.confirmationHint: Pending local work is checked again. The address is saved and the POS runtime restarted only when the candidate server is reachable.
serverConnection.testPassed: Connection passed. This address can be used.
serverConnection.testFailed: Connection failed or the address is not trusted by this build.
serverConnection.saveBlocked: Connection testing is available during startup. Safe switching is enabled after the local ledger is ready.
serverConnection.saved: Server saved. Restarting the POS runtime.
serverConnection.saveFailed: Switch blocked or failed. The current server is retained when local work is pending.
status.languageSwitchHint: Show all interface text in Chinese.
